description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single ranged hybrid attacks (0.70 or 1.68 each), grants [Attach Fire], [Quick Cast 1], [Fire Quick Cycle] and [Firetooth Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Fire Quick Cycle
description.text: Grants [Quick Cast 1] after using a Fire ability

description.name: Firetooth Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Firetooth after using a Fire ability
